study_design: Cross-sectional ecological study of country-level prostate cancer incidence, prevalence, and mortality rates in 170 countries.
reason: This ecological analysis evaluates country-level overall prostate cancer incidence, prevalence, and mortality rates. It does not analyze incident aggressive prostate cancer in an initially cancer-free cohort. Discussion language about progression and metastasis does not establish an aggressive incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Intake of alcohol was associated with increased incidence, prevalence and mortality rates of prostate cancer (β 1.8, P < 0.001; β 4.5, P < 0.001; β 0.4, P < 0.001; respectively).
estimate_classifications.reason: The first reported alcohol association is with the overall prostate cancer incidence rate. The abstract reports a regression coefficient and P value, not an odds ratio or a 95% confidence interval; nevertheless, the endpoint itself is clearly general incidence.
